scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p client --noEmit && tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit
